Error.Cancelled: Confirmation did not match or the operation was cancelled.
Error.UnsafeStore: RansomGuard state storage has overly broad permissions. Reuse was refused. Inspect it and explicitly recover the store from this window.
Error.BusyStore: First stop all RansomGuard services and audit consoles cleanly. Recovery does not terminate processes automatically.

Error.StatePartial: The archive or new store may have changed. Review technical details and run inspection only, not recovery again.
State.Title: RansomGuard state storage
State.Warning: Recovery requires the service to be stopped. The old folder is renamed UNTRUSTED and a fresh store is created for SYSTEM and Administrators only. Old rules and incidents are not imported. No files are deleted.
State.ArchiveLimits: Before moving the old store, access to its root is restricted to SYSTEM and Administrators. Contents inside are not rewritten and already-open handles are not closed. The archive remains untrusted.
State.NoRepair: Permissions are already correct. Recovery is unnecessary.
State.Confirm: Review the consequences and type QUARANTINE. This does NOT install or start the service.
State.Done: A fresh private store was created. Old folder: {0}. Close this window and reopen service installation.
State.Preview: ACL inspection preview. No filesystem access.

Setup.Title: Set up RansomGuard
Setup.ChooseHelp: Choose the folders to monitor. This version records suspicious activity without blocking applications.
Setup.ReviewHelp: Review your folders and the next action. Nothing is installed until you confirm.
Setup.ResetHelp: Previous application settings have overly broad permissions and cannot be reused. You can preserve them separately and create new settings.
Setup.WaitDetails: The result will appear here. No command-line steps are needed.
Setup.ErrorHelp: Before retrying, we will check the current state.
Setup.Preview: PREVIEW · synthetic data, no Windows changes
Setup.DoNotClose: Wait for the current operation to finish. Force-closing does not undo changes already made.
Setup.AuditBoundary: Monitoring only. Automatic application blocking and the kernel driver are not enabled.
Setup.NoFoldersHelp: For example, Documents, Desktop or a work folder. Check the path, especially if Windows requested a different account.
Setup.PlanStart: RansomGuard will install its background component and start it. The interface will reconnect automatically.
Setup.PlanNoStart: RansomGuard will install its background component without starting it. You can start it later in Settings.
Setup.AutoOn: Start with Windows: enabled by your choice.
Setup.ResetAction: Preserve old settings and create new
Setup.DocumentsHelp: Only RansomGuard application data is affected. Your personal files are not moved or deleted.
Setup.Rules: Trust rules must be set up again
Setup.RulesHelp: Previous trust rules and internal settings will not be applied automatically.
Setup.OldData: Previous logs will be kept separately
Setup.OldDataHelp: Old files are moved to a separate untrusted archive. Access to the archive root is restricted to SYSTEM and Administrators; child file ACLs are not rewritten.
Setup.NoMalwareClaim: This settings issue alone does not mean malware was found.
Setup.ResetConsent: I understand that old rules will not be transferred and old service data will be moved to a separate untrusted archive.
Setup.CreateConsent: Allow RansomGuard to create its application settings.
Setup.FirstTimeStore: No application data exists yet. A new RansomGuard settings directory will be created with restricted access.
Setup.NoResetRequired: Permissions passed the checks. Nothing needs to be reset.
Setup.PreparedNoStart: Application settings are ready. The background component was not installed or started.
Setup.ContinueReview: Your folder selection is kept in this form. Select Next to review installation again.
Setup.CanStartLater: Monitoring has not started. You can start it in Settings.
Setup.CheckOverview: Return to Overview to check whether file monitoring is actually working. A running component alone does not prove monitoring is healthy.
Setup.NoMonitoring: RansomGuard is no longer monitoring files. You can start it again in Settings.
Setup.FilesPreserved: Program files, settings and logs have been preserved. Monitoring is not running.
Setup.ControlUnavailable: The current state or settings check does not permit this action. Close this window and refresh the status in Settings.
Setup.RetryHelp: Completed steps may remain applied. The button below only checks again, without forcing changes.
Setup.InstalledButFailed: The component was installed, but a later step did not finish. Check its status before retrying. It will not be overwritten.
Setup.NotInstalled: The component is not installed. Close this window and choose Set up RansomGuard.
Setup.DifferentPackage: The installed copy does not match this interface release or failed verification. Use a complete matching release. No automatic replacement is performed.
Setup.ResetBlocked: We could not confirm that the old data can be moved. Close an old RansomGuard console or stop its component, then check again. No change is forced.
Setup.StartNotConfirmed: Startup could not be confirmed. Check the current state and technical details.
Setup.start.Title: Start monitoring?
Setup.start.Help: RansomGuard will start the installed component. Applications will not be blocked.
Setup.stop.Title: Stop monitoring?
Setup.stop.Help: After stopping, RansomGuard will no longer receive file events. The interface will stay open.
Setup.stop.Consent: I understand that file monitoring will stop.
Setup.restart.Title: Restart the component?
Setup.restart.Help: Monitoring will stop temporarily. Check its state in Overview after startup.
Setup.restart.Consent: I understand that monitoring will be unavailable during restart.
Setup.uninstall.Title: Remove the background component from Windows?
Setup.uninstall.Help: Only the stopped service registration will be removed. Files, settings and logs will not be deleted.
Setup.uninstall.Consent: I understand that the component will no longer run as a Windows service.
Setup.SettingsHelp: The background component runs independently of this window. Set it up once without using a command prompt.
Setup.NoStateGuess: File-monitoring health is shown in Overview.

RuleUx.AccountUnavailable: The account could not be resolved. Select a running application or review advanced settings.
RuleUx.FutureRuns: current and future launches until expiry
RuleUx.UserWarning: Your current administrator account is shown. To target another user, select their running application.
RuleUx.ProcessSelected: Application and account selected. Review folders and expiry.

RuleUx.DisableConsent: Disable the selected rule and return to the normal monitoring policy.
RuleUx.RemoveConsent: Remove the selected rule. Previous incidents will remain in the log.

RecoveryReview.TruncatedHelp: Plan contains {0} actions; this elevated review shows the first {1}.

RecoveryReview.PreviewActive: Synthetic active session. Planning remains unavailable until the session reaches a terminal lifecycle state.
